meta_description:
187K likes, 362 comments - natgeo on October 19, 2026: "Presented by @Rolex. In the forests of East and Central Africa, the population of endangered mountain gorillas has nearly doubled since the 1990s, but diseases transmitted by humans remain a serious threat to their survival. Hoping to reduce this risk, National Geographic Explorer Gladys Kalema-Zikusoka is working with communities near Uganda’s Bwindi Impenetrable National Park to improve healthcare and hygiene.

Through its partnership with the National Geographic Society and as part of its Perpetual Planet Initiative, #Rolex supports expeditions exploring and protecting remarkable places around the world, a selection of which are featured in Africa Earth’s Wild Home. #PerpetualPlanet

#AfricaEarthsWildHome now streaming on @DisneyPlus and @hulu.

Learn more at the link in bio.

Photographs by @hammond_robin".
